slides.title: Should your small business do Black Friday?

slides.heading: What do you want from it?
slides.body: New clients, less stock or cash before December? A sale should serve a goal, not the calendar.

slides.heading: Check your margin first
slides.body: Work out what you keep after the discount. If the number makes you wince, it's not the right offer.

slides.heading: Add, don't cut
slides.body: A bonus, a bundle or early access can feel generous without lowering your price.

slides.heading: Skipping is allowed
slides.body: Not joining is a decision too. Tell your people why, and let your regular prices stay calm.

slides.title: Save this before the sales get loud
slides.body: Decide now, so 27 November feels easy.
